All 18 rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position on the HDI Site Development and Hosting Agreement:

**Critical gaps (inserted clauses):**
- **LOL-CAP** — no limitation of liability at all; added a mutual cap (greater of 12 months' fees / USD 1M) with confidentiality, indemnity, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside it.
- **INDEMN** — no indemnity of any kind from the party that builds, hosts and processes order data; added the standard HDI IP/breach-of-law/data-breach indemnity.
- **IP** — ownership is entirely unallocated, so HDI would own the Site with no licence back and no confirmation we own our Content and customer data; added an ownership and licence-back provision.

**Other deviations redlined:**
- **LD** — one-way, uncapped Termination Payment (50% of trailing Net Sales over $800k) capped at 3 months' fees.
- **NONCOMPETE** — open-ended restraint on us ("products substantially similar", "companies similar to") narrowed to a Deerskin-branded competing site with internal-development/acquisition carve-outs.
- **WARRANTY** — only corporate-authority reps; added performance/conformance warranty with remedy.
- **RENEWAL** — 90-day non-renewal window shortened to 30 days for us, HDI left at 90.
- **LICENSE** — Section 1.4 access extended to affiliates, contractors and successors.
- **AUDIT** — added a once-per-12-months limit (notice, cost and no system access were already acceptable).
- **INSURANCE / TRANSITION** — both absent for a hosting vendor; short paragraphs inserted.

**Acceptable as drafted:** GOVLAW (New York), ASSIGN (free assignment, no change-of-control trigger), MFN and NOSOLICIT (nothing burdening us), MINCOMMIT (pure revenue share), T4C and EXCLUSIVITY (both at fallback; the related penalty and scope points are redlined once, under LD and NONCOMPETE respectively, to avoid double-flagging).
